scenario.summary: Unauthenticated attackers exploit critical zero-day and authentication bypass vulnerabilities in N-able N-central to gain full administrative access. The intrusion involves reconnaissance of specific API endpoints, rogue account creation using subtle email suffixes like '.invalid', and persistence via Cloudflare tunnels and masqueraded binaries before moving laterally across the environment.

meta.rationale: Start with servers identified by the scoping query. Focus on domain controllers if management account anomalies are detected, as the report indicates prioritisation of targeting DCs.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has established persistence on an N-central server using Cloudflare tunnels or masqueraded binaries (e.g., svchost.exe in Documents), and moved laterally using hijacked 'MSP Support' credentials.

blind_spots.risk: Attackers can delete or rotate logs (envoy_proxy, syslog) to hide the initial exploit chain; the hunt would only see the persistent binary residue.
blind_spots.question: Did exploitation occur prior to the current logging window?
blind_spots.requires: extended log retention on N-central appliances
blind_spots.remediation: Configure N-central logs to be forwarded to a central SIEM.

blind_spots.risk: If the appliance is a black-box Linux VM without an agent, file and process activity cannot be verified directly.
blind_spots.question: Is the masqueraded binary running on the appliance itself?
blind_spots.remediation: Deploy endpoint sensors to all management appliances.

hunt.name: N-central Persistence and Lateral Movement
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on post-exploitation activity following an N-central compromise. It examines three distinct surfaces: process execution for masqueraded binaries (svchost.exe in user folders) and Cloudflare tunnel services, network connections to known intruder VPN infrastructure, and authentication logs for the 'MSP Support' account used during Take Control abuse. An analyst-agent weighs the combined evidence to identify compromised management infrastructure.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%n-central%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%n-able%') AND asset_scope = 'endpoint'
config.description: Scope the hunt to systems where N-central or N-able software is installed.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames running N-central management software. This provides the primary scope for the hunt.

primitive_config.label: Identify N-central Infrastructure
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%n-central%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%n-able%') AND asset_scope = 'endpoint'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames running N-central management software. This provides the primary scope for the hunt.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, user_name, time, process_name FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%cloudflared%' OR (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe' AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\\\documents\\\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\\\users\\\\public\\\\%'))) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find Cloudflared services or svchost.exe masquerading in user documents, as reported in N-central incidents.
config.expected_signal: svchost.exe running from a non-standard path or the presence of the Cloudflared utility. svchost.exe in user profiles is a high-confidence indicator of masquerading.

primitive_config.label: Detect Malicious Persistence Binaries
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_path, process_cmd_line, user_name, time, process_name FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%cloudflared%' OR (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe' AND (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\\\documents\\\\%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\\\\users\\\\public\\\\%'))) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: svchost.exe running from a non-standard path or the presence of the Cloudflared utility. svchost.exe in user profiles is a high-confidence indicator of masquerading.

config.content: SELECT process_name, process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%cloudflared%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, process_path HAVING host_count <= 3
config.description: Stack-count the suspected persistence binaries to confirm they are unique to compromised hosts.
config.expected_signal: A result identifying the persistence binary as rare (seen on 3 or fewer hosts).

primitive_config.label: Prevalence of persistence binaries
primitive_config.content: SELECT process_name, process_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%cloudflared%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%svchost.exe%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_name, process_path HAVING host_count <= 3
primitive_config.expected: A result identifying the persistence binary as rare (seen on 3 or fewer hosts).

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, process_name, connection_state, COUNT(*) as count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE instr(',' || '{{c2_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, process_name
